flows:
Navigate to https://gs.statcounter.com/ then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Remain on this public site.
Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
Assert that the Edit Chart Data control below the main chart is keyboard focusable.
Open it using the keyboard and verify the chart settings form shows the Region selector.

summary:
The page loaded and showed the Edit Chart Data button, but the agent performed an analysis and immediately made the focusability assertion. It did not use the required keyboard navigation to place focus on the visible control, so the failed check does not demonstrate that the site control is broken.
Restart from the loaded chart, use Tab or Shift+Tab until the Edit Chart Data button visibly receives focus, then press Enter and confirm that the settings form includes the Region selector.
one_liner: The run checked whether the Edit Chart Data control could receive keyboard focus before using Tab to reach it.
